12. We keep hearing in media that Aadhaar data was breached. Is this true?
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
Data of all Aadhaar number holders is safe and secure in the Central Identities Data Repository (CIDR) of UIDAI. Aadhaar database in CIDR has never been breached in all these years of its existence.
